summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd), a B7-H3 antibody drug conjugate, with treatment of physician's choice in adults with relapsed small cell lung cancer. I-DXd is given as 12 mg/kg intravenously on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, until progression, unacceptable toxicity, or other stop criteria in the protocol are met. The record states that the study compares efficacy and safety, but it does not state a primary outcome.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd), un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a B7-H3, con el tratamiento a criterio del médico en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas recidivante. I-DXd se administra a 12 mg/kg por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, hasta la progresión, toxicidad inaceptable u otros criterios de suspensión definidos en el protocolo. El registro indica que el estudio compara la eficacia y la seguridad, pero no indica un desenlace primario.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.
Received only one prior platinum-based systemic therapy line for small cell lung cancer, with at least 2 cycles.
Chemotherapy-free interval of at least 30 days from end of platinum to radiologic progression.
At least one measurable lesion according to RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less within 7 days before Cycle 1 Day 1.
not_for: Prior treatment with B7-H3 targeted agents, including I-DXd.
Prior discontinuation of an exatecan-derivative antibody drug conjugate due to treatment-related toxicity.
Prior treatment with any study comparator drug or any topoisomerase I inhibitor.
Stroke, transient ischemic attack, or other arterial thromboembolic event within the past 6 months.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or suspected interstitial lung disease that cannot be ruled out.
